title: Tech Note: The Power of 4D for iOS
author: Nhat Do, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D for iOS (the native Swift/Xcode-generating mobile tool showcased here) was discontinued by 4D; the entire product line described in this tech note no longer exists in current 4D versions, making this note purely of historical interest.
related_updates: 4D for iOS / 4D Mobile App generation was discontinued as a 4D product line
Modern 4D mobile strategy centers on responsive web apps built with ORDA/REST and, for low-code app building, 4D's separate Qodly platform, rather than generating native Xcode projects from within 4D
